claim: In the stock exe code: ship facing is a separate rotate command: ctor 0x599810 (Selection*, int16 angle = degrees * 65536/360, bool flag, bool queue; ret 0x10) + push 0x58dc60; the dispatcher codes 0..3 build it with (-a, 0), (+a, 0), (+a, 1), (-a, 1). Open: absolute or relative angle, the flag, the heading sign convention against napoleon.battle.bearing_convention
